name: Teacher Planner Company
voice: Teacher-to-teacher. Warm, professional and genuinely practical — never corporate, never cutesy. Built on the brand promise 'Designed especially for teachers by teachers': we know the real demands of a school day, so the planner is designed to streamline your workload and give you more time for what really matters. Calm and reassuring against the chaos of lesson plans, timetables, meetings, deadlines and loose paperwork. Confident about quality (luxury-feel leatherette, premium paper) without bragging.
tagline: Designed especially for teachers, by teachers.
photo_rules: CLEAN, PROFESSIONAL, CALM — a real UK teacher's world, never childish clip-art. Palette: deep leatherette PURPLE #5A2D82 + leatherette BLUE #2E6FB7 on white and soft lilac-grey #F4F2F8. CRITICAL FOR THIS CATEGORY: the INTERIOR sells the planner — show real, legible page spreads, not just a closed cover. Must-show: the improved SIX-PERIOD daily layout (the core differentiator), monthly planning tables, yearly calendars, term dates, meeting pages, timetable and notes sections, the laminated TABBED pocket dividers fanned out, and BOTH plastic storage wallets including the V-shaped one holding real worksheets. Prove the build: soft-touch leatherette cover, elasticated closure cord, reinforced wiro coil binding, hardboard cover and the 200-page thickness (a side-on shot — 'feels thinner than expected' is a real review complaint). Always state the academic year 2026-2027 clearly and give an A4 size reference (approx. 300 x 250 mm, next to a pen or on a desk). Show the colour variants (purple + blue). Styling: tidy teacher desk / staffroom, natural daylight, a pen, a mug, a few marked books — aspirational but real. UK ENGLISH throughout (organiser, colour, timetable, personalised). Overlays PUNCHY (<=5 words), one idea per image.
no_gos: No childish or cutesy clip-art, cartoon apples, crayon scribbles or primary-school stock — it undercuts the professional, luxury-feel positioning. Never leave the academic year ambiguous (a real review complaint is that the year did not match expectations) — 2026-2027 must be unmistakable. Do not show only the closed cover; a planner is bought on its interior. No 'best / #1 / guaranteed'. No prices, URLs or discount flashes on-image. Avoid US spelling (use organiser, colour, timetable). No cluttered, messy or dark scenes — the brand sells calm and control.

notes:
Teacher Planner Company (TeacherPlanner Co Ltd) — UK brand selling premium academic planners for teachers. Website: teacherplannercompany.co.uk. Sells on amazon.co.uk. Brand promise on site: 'Designed especially for teachers by teachers' and organisers that 'streamline your workload, giving you more time to focus on what really matters'.

LEATHERETTE COLLECTION: Leatherette Blue (2026-27) and Leatherette Purple (2026-27), RRP GBP 16.99, 'a luxury feel Leatherette covering', contemporary style.

PRODUCT 01 = 'A4 PARENT Teacher Planner - Flex Union' (a PARENT listing with colour/variant children; SEO tabs reference child ASINs B0FCJ71NXF, B0FCJQLNWL, B0FCJPT94B, B0FCJPKH6W). Academic year 2026-2027.

PRODUCT USPs: A4, improved SIX-PERIOD daily format, approx. 300 x 250 mm · 200 planning pages · yearly calendars, monthly planning tables, term dates, meeting pages, timetables, notes sections · laminated tabbed pocket dividers · TWO built-in plastic storage wallets incl. an extra V-shaped wallet · reinforced sturdy coil / wiro binding · premium paper + durable hardboard cover · luxury-feel leatherette covering, soft-touch finish, elasticated closure cord.

TARGET: teachers, teaching assistants, trainee teachers, department heads, supply teachers and other education professionals organising the 2026-2027 academic year. PROBLEMS: juggling lesson plans, timetables, meetings, deadlines, notes and loose documents in one place; disorganisation, forgotten tasks, wasted time and work-related stress.

VoC POSITIVE: practical layout · generous writing space · tabbed sections quick to find · sturdy, well-made · good-quality paper · spacious yet practical size · strong value for money · attractive colours and cover designs. VoC OBJECTIONS TO DEFUSE ON-IMAGE: (1) 'product details / academic-year information may not match expectations' -> make 2026-2027 unmistakable and state contents precisely; (2) 'some planners feel thinner than expected versus premium alternatives' -> prove substance with a side-on 200-page thickness shot, hardboard cover and wiro coil.
